title: Full Stack AI
description:
Full\\-Stack Product Engineer, AI
 



  





 Location — Hyderabad, India (Hybrid)
 



 Employment type — Full\\-time
 



 Experience — \\~3–6 years, or a body of shipped work that speaks for itself
 



 Compensation — Competitive with market
 



  





  





 ABOUT AIRAWATH
 



  





 Airawath is an AI\\-powered e\\-invitation and event platform. People describe
 



 the celebration they're planning; we generate the invitation design, deliver
 



 it over SMS, email, and push, track RSVPs, and run the gift registry around
 



 it. Elie, our recommendation layer, helps guests find the right gift.
 



  





 We're a growing in\\-house engineering team working directly with the founders.
 



  





  





 ABOUT THE ROLE
 



  





 Problems here don't arrive divided into frontend and backend tickets. You'll
 



 own features end to end — understand the user problem, design the schema,
 



 build the APIs and the interface, integrate the AI layer, deploy it, and
 



 measure whether it changed anything. You'll own systems rather than a queue,
 



 and you'll have the latitude to decide how they get built.
 



  





  





 RESPONSIBILITIES
 



  





 In your first year you'd likely own two or three of these outright:
 



  





 • AI invitation generation. The text\\-to\\-image pipeline behind every design —
 



 prompt construction, model selection, cost and latency per generation, and
 



 the eval loop that tells us whether output quality actually moved.
 



  





 • Notification delivery. One invitation fans out to SMS, email, and push
 



 across timezones. Deliverability, retries, idempotency, and the telemetry
 



 that proves a guest was genuinely reached.
 



  





 • Credits and payments. The credit economy behind AI generation, and the
 



 payments layer on top of it. Money code — the highest bar in the codebase.
 



  





 • Elie, gift discovery. Parameter\\-based and conversational recommendation
 



 over a live product catalogue. Retrieval, structured outputs, and the
 



 judgment to know when an answer shouldn't come from a model at all.
 



  





 For any of them you'd write the migration, the API, the web surface, the AI
 



 layer, the deployment, and the dashboard that says whether it worked.
 



  





  





 MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
 



  





 • Production React, TypeScript, and Next.js. You've shipped and then
 



 maintained real interfaces, not just built them once.
 



  





 • Production Python, including async. Our backend is FastAPI on SQLAlchemy
 



 2\\.0 async, where the interesting problems are session and transaction
 



 semantics rather than syntax.
 



  





 • PostgreSQL judgment. Schema design, relationships, indexing, and the
 



 ability to read a query plan. We hand\\-write SQL migrations and apply them
 



 to a live production database.
 



  





 • You've shipped an LLM\\-powered feature that real people used. Not a demo —
 



 you can speak to what it cost per call, where it failed, and how you knew
 



 it was working.
 



  





 • You've deployed and debugged your own code in production. AWS (EC2, RDS,
 



 S3\\), Docker, and CI. When something breaks at 11pm, you're the one reading
 



 the logs.
 



  





  





 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
 



  





 • AI agent or multi\\-agent workflows; RAG, embeddings, vector search, and
 



 retrieval evaluation.
 



 • Evaluation frameworks for LLM accuracy, reliability, latency, and cost.
 



 • Flutter or native mobile development — we have a mobile app, and you'd
 



 occasionally touch it.
 



 • Streaming and real\\-time systems: WebSockets, server\\-sent events, voice.
 



 • Redis, queues, event\\-driven architectures, AWS Lambda or ECS.
 



 • Observability, logging, monitoring, and production analytics.
 



 • Early\\-stage startup experience, or open\\-source and independently launched
 



 work.
 



  





  





 HOW WE WORK
 



  





 • Own the outcome. You're accountable for whether the feature worked, not
 



 whether it shipped. Everything you own gets a metric you chose.
 



  





 • Short decision paths, real review discipline. You don't need a committee
 



 to pick an approach. But anything touching money, authentication, or
 



 migrations gets read line by line — yours and ours.
 



  





 • AI by default. Cursor, Claude Code, Codex — whatever gets you there. We
 



 care that you know where the tools are unreliable, not that you use them.
 



  





 • Keep it practical. The simplest reliable thing that creates impact. We'd
 



 rather delete code than add a layer.
 



  





  





 Airawath is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified
 



 applicants without regard to race, religion, colour, sex, sexual orientation,
 



 gender identity, age, national origin, disability, marital status, or any
 



 other characteristic protected by law.

* Extensive experience with building enterprise\\-scale applications with \\>99% SLAs
* Extensive Experience in Python, and GCP

* Competitive compensation package including equity
* Collaborative, high\\-performance team environment
* Professional growth opportunities in a fast\\-scaling startup
* Chance to make significant impact on product direction through customer insights
* Culture that values innovation, technical excellence, and work\\-life balance


**Our Culture**
**Who we are:** 
 Led by two pioneering co\\-founders we are one of the fastest growing companies in the U.S., creating our own category of enterprise autonomous software development. We automate thousands of hours of software development for our customers, which includes strong representation within the Fortune 500\\.
   

  

**How We Work**
**We move Blitzy Fast:** 
 Time is both our company's and our clients' most precious asset. We move quickly and decisively to innovate internally and deliver exceptional software externally.
   

  

**Championship Mindset:** 
 We operate like a professional sports team. We win as a team by holding ourselves and each other to high standards, collaborating in\\-person, and remaining focused on the mission.
   

  

**Passion for Invention:** 
 We're pushing the frontier of what's possible, requiring constant innovation and iteration.
   

  

**We Work for the Customer:** 
 We focus on delivering outsized value to the customers we work with and expanding those relationships into deep, meaningful partnerships.
